notes.name: Electrician's Note
notes.text: Today was another power outage. These things are happening more and more frequently. Not only does it scare the passengers, but we also get complaints from security that their systems are offline. Like it's our fault that the city cheaped out on renovating this place.**Anyway, we've given the keys to the power box to the security office, so that when the power goes out they can restart the breakers. This should keep them from whining for now.
